expectations.text: 主术语用 Shunt release（含大小写变体 Shunt Release），不以北美 Shunt trip 或禁用 shunt opening release / Excitation release 作为主术语
expectations.evidence: Body L12-13: "**Shunt Release (SHT / MX)** ... and the shunt release"; Table L24: "Shunt release (SHT / MX)" and excludes "Excitation release, Shunting release, Shunt opening release; North American / UL only: Shunt Trip (ST)".

expectations.text: 闭合电磁铁用 Track 1 样本语体 Closing release（可括注 closing coil），不用 Track 2 Closed electromagnet 或禁用 Closing electromagnet / Close electromagnet
expectations.evidence: Body L13: "Both the closing release (CC / CEM) and the shunt release"; Table L28: "Closing release (CC / CEM) (admitted synonym: closing coil)" and excludes Track 2 "Closed electromagnet (CEM)" and forbidden "Close electromagnet, Closing magnet".

expectations.text: 钥匙锁用 Track 1 样本语体 ACB Key Lock (KLC)（或 ACB Key Lock / Circuit-breaker key lock），不用 Track 2 Keys and locks (KL) 或直译 Body key lock
expectations.evidence: Body L15: "**ACB Key Lock (KLC)**"; Table L30: "ACB Key Lock (KLC) / circuit-breaker key lock", excluding Track 2 "Keys and locks (KL)" and forbidden "Body key lock".

expectations.text: 开孔工具用样本语体 hole saw / panel hole saw 或 hole punch，不用说明书语体 hole opener
expectations.evidence: Body L16: "using a panel hole saw or hole punch"; Table L32: "panel hole saw or hole punch | Track 1 catalogue standard | Track 2 OEM manual: hole opener".

expectations.text: 遵循 IEC 60947-2:2024 英式拼写与连字符规范：正文统一使用连字符 circuit-breaker（非无连字符 circuit breaker），且通电用词采用 -ize 拼写（pulse-energized / pulse energization，非 energis*）
expectations.evidence: Body L13: "Remotely opens the circuit-breaker", "pulse energization working mode", "energization interval t2"; L29 excludes "-ise" ("energisation"); zero unhyphenated "circuit breaker" in deliverable body.

expectations.text: 保留 t1 用不小于/≥（not less than 200 ms / ≥ 200 ms）与 t2 用大于/>（greater than 15 s / more than 15 s / > 15 s）的不对称边界，未统一为同一个符号
expectations.evidence: Body L13: "ensure that the pulse time t1 is not less than 200 ms and the energization interval t2 is greater than 15 s" — preserves >= vs > asymmetry.

expectations.text: 数字与单位之间严格有单个半角空格（50 ms / 200 ms / 15 s / 28 mm），无粘连写法
expectations.evidence: Body L13 & L16: "50 ms", "200 ms", "15 s", "Ø 28 mm"; L41 explicitly confirms single half-width space before every SI unit.

expectations.text: 显式说明原文未提供额定控制电源电压的具体电压值，未编造任何电压数值
expectations.evidence: Table L26: "no assumed voltage rating added"; L43: "No unstated ratings (such as specific control voltage values, frame sizes, series designations, or power consumption) were invented or inherited".
